adaptation: The semantic identity import uses the current computer-content owner. A bounded receiver fix validates NI syntax with the current URI owner before path resolution and uses O_NOFOLLOW when reading dataset files or verifying a write collision. Original objectKind, dataset identity inputs, byte limit, immutable-write behavior, credential-key refusals and original test semantics are preserved. Nonblocking file open lets the regular-file guard reject FIFOs without waiting for a writer.
licensing: The original source and package manifest carry no explicit license header or field. This record preserves provenance and makes no license grant.
readBoundary: The caller owns and trusts the configured root and its ancestors. The provider rejects malformed/noncanonical NI values and final-component symlinks; it does not claim to secure hostile replacement of ancestor directories or a caller-supplied root.
